newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Sunken 19th century ship found in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Sunken 19th century ship found in Philippines.

text.p: Divers have retrieved artifacts from a ship that may have come from China and sank in the southwestern Philippines in 1816, the Coast Guard said on Thursday.
A search by two French divers commissioned by the Philippine government has so far yielded about 200 artifacts, mainly jars and plates, a coast guard statement said.
The ship, about 50 feet (15 metres) long and 24 feet (seven metres) wide, resembled a Chinese vessel, it said.
It was found last month about 180 feet (55 metres) off Busuanga island near the northern tip of the main southwestern island of Palawan.
